name: Getting Your Garage Door Installation Right: A Checklist
description: Getting Your Garage Door Installation Right: A Checklist

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Getting a new garage door or upgrading an old one can seem like a big project, but with a good plan, it’ll go smoothly. Here’s a quick checklist to help you get started:

step.name: Step 2
step.text: 1.  **Measure Your Opening:** Double-check the width and height of your garage door opening. Accuracy here is key to ensure your new door fits perfectly.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: 2.  **Choose Your Style & Material:** Think about insulation value, durability, noise, and security. Do you want steel, wood, or something else? Consider your home's aesthetic too!

step.name: Step 4
step.text: 3.  **Confirm Opener Compatibility:** Will your existing opener work with the new door, or is it time for an upgrade there too? Make sure they're a good match.

step.name: Step 5
step.text: 4.  **Consider All Components:** An upgrade often means looking at new springs, tracks, sensors, and weather sealing. These all contribute to performance and longevity.

step.name: Step 6
step.text: 5.  **Check Local Permits:** In areas like Denver, structural changes or new electrical work for an opener might require a permit or inspection. It's smart to confirm this upfront.

step.name: Step 7
step.text: 6.  **Review Safety Features:** Ensure the new door and opener include essential safety features like auto-reverse and photo eyes. Safety first!

step.name: Step 8
step.text: Once you’ve got these points covered, you’ll be well on your way to a successful installation. If any of this feels overwhelming, especially when it comes to things like torsion springs or electrical connections, don't hesitate to bring in a professional. They can handle the complexities and ensure everything is installed safely and to code, giving you peace of mind.
